message.reasoning_content: Round 3 of 6, price list: sold_counter=2, price 9 for next. Sell 3 units: 9+8+7=24. Later rounds: I get more goods each round (subsidy=1, produce 3, shuttle 4). Prices will decline. Cash devaluation round starts: cash=floor(cash/100)*62 — 62% retention. Selling now gives cash that devalues twice (r4, r5 starts? starts of rounds 2 and later). Actually each round start ≥2 devalues. So cash from r3 devalues at r4, r5, r6 starts: 0.62^3 ≈ 0.238. Promissory doesn't devalue until paid at round start... promissory added at start next round, then devalues each subsequent start. Sell_credit: 30 alashi promissory paid at r4 start, then devalued twice (r5, r6): 30*0.62^2=11.5. Sell cash 24 → 24*0.238=5.7. So credit much better. Also price declines as others sell; selling now at higher price. Sell all 3 on credit: choice 6.
